summary: Iteration 9 tested the lean bracket search strategy and model-aware TP selection formula on the largest model (llama-3.1-70b) across 3 GPUs and 2 request rates. All four arms were confirmed: the lean bracket found global-best configurations in just 2 evaluations on all 30 runs, the model-aware formula achieved 100% accuracy (24/24 cumulative) versus 75% for the old formula, and results were fully deterministic and robust across 50 seed combinations.
key_points: h-main CONFIRMED: TP=8 wins on all 6 regimes (3 hardware × 2 rates) for 70B, matching exact global-best scores (e.g., H100 r500=0.091801). evals_to_best=2 on all 30 runs (5 seeds × 6 regimes), meaning the lean bracket finds the optimum after evaluating only TP=4 then TP=8. All 5 search seeds produce identical results per regime (deterministic).

h-control-negative CONFIRMED: The model-aware formula goes 24/24 (100%) across all models/regimes tested in the campaign. The old formula scores 18/24 (75%), failing exactly on 6 regimes where load_index exceeds threshold 12.0 and rate > crossover — it predicts TP=4 but actual winner is TP=8, with scores 9.3–16.9% below best. The load_index threshold mechanism is validated as the precise discriminator.

h-ablation CONFIRMED: A default (non-optimized) parameter profile still correctly identifies TP=8 as winner on all 6 regimes for 70B, but scores are 15–19% below the max-profile global best. This confirms the 70B TP=8 advantage is structural (weight-transfer physics) rather than batch-size dependent — the right TP choice matters more than fine-tuning other knobs.

h-robustness CONFIRMED: 50/50 correct across all BLIS-seed × search-seed combinations on H100 and L40S. Minimum TP=8 margin is 2.4% (H100, blis_seed=45), still clearing the >2% threshold. L40S margins are larger (11.7–20.3%). Full determinism confirmed within each blis_seed.

Campaign cumulative: lean bracket achieves 75/75 correct TP selections across 4 models (8B, 14B, 32B, 70B), 3 GPUs (H100, A100-SXM, L40S), and 2 request rates, with only 2 simulator evaluations needed per regime.
